Welcome Email 2 · Note from Stefan · 4 hours later · Plain text

Design A — Plain text, as it lands in the inbox
Stefan at Arq8Why I built Arq8 the way I did — The decisions I made on purpose.

Hi,

Stefan here. I founded Arq8.

I built a busy, demanding life that moves fast. It only works if I am on point. So what matters to me is staying capable every day, mentally and physically, at 100 percent.

Creatine is one of the most studied supplements there is. Yet most adults never take it, because the products were made for bodybuilders, taste like chalk, or are packed with sugar.

So here is what I decided on purpose.

99.9% pure creatine. Not the cheapest input, but the one I would take myself.

1000 mesh, made with Swiss patent pending technology, about 5x finer than the 200 mesh most creatine uses. It dissolves fully into the gummy, so there is no grit and no chalky aftertaste.

The full 5 g in every serving with 0 g sugar. A lighter dose would have cost us less to make. It would also have been pointless.

And proof instead of promises. Informed Sport certified. Clean Label Project certified. 5,018 mg per serving on the latest lab test. Over 5 g of creatine per serving kept after 9 months of stability testing.

What made you curious about creatine? Hit reply, I read these.

https://arq-8.com/products/arq8-creatine-monohydrate-gummies

Stefan

P.S. Your welcome code is A8-WK15Q, 15% off your first order.

Arq84 gummies. That is the whole thing. — How to take them, in 4 steps.

How to take Arq8, in 4 steps.

There is no step five.

READ THE DOSING GUIDE

The 4 steps

  1. 1.Four gummies, once a day, every day. That is the full 5 g.
  2. 2.Any time of day, with or without food. Most people tie it to something they already do, like morning coffee.
  3. 3.Every day, including rest days. No cycling.
  4. 4.No loading phase needed. Just start.

What to expect, and when

Creatine builds up in your muscles over about 4 weeks of daily use. Do not judge it in week one.

A tip for never missing a day: keep the pack next to the coffee maker or your toothbrush.

What is in every serving

5 g of 99.9% pure, 1000 mesh creatine plus taurine, succinic acid and zinc. 0 g sugar.
Informed Sport and Clean Label Project certified.
Over 5 g of creatine per serving kept after 9 months of stability testing.

When this pack runs out

The 3 pack subscription is $118 for three months, about $39 a month, ships free, with free Magnesium+ Gummies and electrolytes.

The 1 pack subscription is $45 a month instead of $59. Skip or cancel anytime.

Or use A8-NX15R for 15% off your next one time order.
